description: Prices at the station in your current sector with item names and the NET amount you receive after sales tax. Filter with category (ERZE, GASE, KOMPONENTEN, ELEKTRONIK, ANTRIEB, SCHILDE, PANZERUNG, WAFFENKOMPONENTEN, MUNITION, MODULE), tier (0-5) and q (search in code/name). Max 200 rows. Read-only; shows the CURRENT station price only -- for the price over time use get_price_history, for used modules offered by players use get_module_listings. To trade use buy, sell, sell_all or place_orders.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

category.description: Optional category filter, one of ERZE, GASE, KOMPONENTEN, ELEKTRONIK, ANTRIEB, SCHILDE, PANZERUNG, WAFFENKOMPONENTEN, MUNITION, MODULE.

q.description: Optional search text matched against item code and name, e.g. TITANIUM.

name: get_market
title: Get station market
